personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Premium B2B SaaS variant - Stripe/Linear vibe)
personality_one_liner: A premium, high-trust operations center that feels as precise and polished as the top-tier cleaning services it manages.

typography.guidance: Max weight 500. Use 17px/400 for highly readable body text (Linear standard). Use slightly negative tracking for 2xl display text to match Stripe's premium feel.

spacing.rule: Linear/Stripe 8pt scale with generous card padding. Avoid dense clustering.

radius_tokens.guidance: md (12px) is the standard for all cards. sm (8px) for small buttons/inputs.

shadow_specs.native: shadowColor: '#0A192F', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 0.04, shadowRadius: 16, elevation: 2

do's: Use for the sticky Driver Mode active offer banner
Use for bottom tab bar background to prevent hard cut-offs
Use for the sticky bottom action bar on Job Details
dont's: Do not use on standard feed cards or metric tiles
Do not use on forms or dense data tables

screens.name: Jobs Marketplace Feed
screens.purpose: Discover and grab available cleaning jobs quickly.

states.loading: Skeleton cards mimicking exact layout, sliding shimmer effect.
states.empty: Illustration of a clipboard/map, 'No jobs in your area', 'Check back later or expand your radius.', Button: 'Update Preferences'

screens.layout: Reduce text density on cards: Remove labels (e.g., instead of 'Date: Oct 12', just show 'Oct 12' in bolder text next to a calendar icon). 1 primary price metric right-aligned. Use spacing.lg (24px) for internal card padding.

screens.name: Operations Command Center
screens.purpose: High-level overview of metrics and live crew activity.

states.loading: Metric tiles skeleton with faint pulse.
states.empty: Illustration of an operations desk. 'Your command center is ready.', 'Invite your first employee to see live stats.', Button: 'Invite Team Member'
states.error: Failed to fetch metrics. 'Refresh Data' CTA.

screens.layout: 2-column grid for metrics (gap: 16px). Only 1 primary number per card (28px), 1 comparison metric (13px, secondary color). No heavy text explanations. Live activity feed uses infinite scroll below metrics.

screens.name: Job Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific job and process its workflow.

states.error: Job not found or removed. 'Back to Jobs' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky primary action button anchored at the bottom with a glass background. Group metadata into visual blocks (Location, Client, Checklist) separated by subtle dividers (1px divider, not cards inside cards).

animations.guidance: Subtle, Stripe-like transitions. Everything should feel instant but smooth.
animations.list_entrance: react-native-reanimated FadeInUp with 300ms duration, subtle spring.
animations.press_scale: Scale down to 0.97 on press (buttons and cards).
animations.skeleton: Smooth, slow opacity pulse (not aggressive left-to-right shimmers).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Stripe/Linear token spacing and font hierarchy to achieve the premium feel. Use the provided shadow specs (boxShadow for web, elevation/shadow for native).
Card Density Fix: Strip out all explicit labels ('Price:', 'Address:', 'Date:'). Use layout and iconography to imply meaning. Limit to one primary metric per card.
Use react-native-reanimated for a universal 0.97 press scale on all interactive cards and primary buttons.
Implement the standardized empty state pattern (Icon -> 17px Title -> 13px Subtext -> Primary CTA) in a reusable component and deploy it across the requested screens.
Ensure the sticky CTA at the bottom of the Job Detail and Driver Mode uses the glassmorphism specs to float gracefully above scrolling content.
